name: Standing Water
description: Shaken water whose standing pattern is read along a circle at the pitch, so a chord swells out of a splash and flickers like light on a pool floor.

params.name: Pattern
params.description: The figure the shaken water settles into, which picks the overtones that stand out. Free never settles, and its waves take turns.

params.name: Reading
params.description: What is read off the water: how high it stands, how steeply it leans, or the light it bends onto the floor.

params.name: Pool
params.description: The shape that holds the water. Round keeps the figure whole, Long squeezes it into a hollow channel, Sea lets every wave travel on.

params.name: Shake
params.description: How hard the water is shaken. More of it raises a taller and brighter figure, and wakes it sooner.

params.name: Threshold
params.description: How much shaking it takes before the figure rises. A key that stays under it leaves only its splash and a faint trembling octave.

params.name: Lag
params.description: How long the figure takes to grow out of the still water once it is shaken.

params.name: Circle
params.description: The size of the circle the water is read along. Small is near a pure tone, wide crosses more crests and brings in higher overtones.

params.name: Depth
params.description: How deep the reading bends: sharper crests, more folded slopes, or light drawn into brighter lines.

params.name: Layers
params.description: Finer ripples that ride on the figure at its own angles and add a second and a third ring of overtones.

params.name: Thickness
params.description: From thin as spirit to thick as oil. Thick water loses its small ripples and lets a splash die soon.

params.name: Unrest
params.description: How unevenly the waves are fed, so that they swell, sink and take over from each other.

params.name: Drift
params.description: How fast everything on the water moves, from a slow turning to a quick flicker.

params.name: Stray
params.description: How far the reading point wanders from the middle of the figure. The farther it goes, the more overtones come and leave.

params.name: Below
params.description: A second halving that wakes after the first and puts a tone an octave under the key.

params.name: Splash
params.description: How hard the key strikes the water: a drop, a spray, beads that fall back and a push to the figure. A key that stays under its threshold keeps a little of it.

params.name: Stone
params.description: The size of what is thrown in, from a pin with a short high drop to a boulder with a long low one.

params.name: Foam
params.description: Air carried on the waves, a breath that follows the pitch and the figure.

params.name: Calm
params.description: How long the water, its splash with it, takes to come to rest after the key is let go.

params.name: Width
params.description: How far apart the two ears stand over the water.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Overall output level of the instrument.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. The waves follow the textbook amplitude equations of a parametrically driven surface (gain, loss, cross saturation by angle); the surface is summed as Bessel series along a circle, bent by its reading and played as a two-cycle table. Levels are voiced by measurement.
